name: Cislunar-Hoodoo
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near a nearby asteroid belt.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Forests of black-leaved flora drink the dim light and exhale a scent like cold iron.
Approach protocols for the smuggler cache are simple: announce once, dock slowly, compliment the cooking.
The quarantine perimeter has held for years, mostly out of mutual disinterest. Everyone checks the fence anyway.
